title: Fit an Ice Harvester I at Central Nexus: the tool every ice field needs
note: A pilot without the module docks at Central Nexus, buys one Ice Harvester I (on offer at 1,413 cr at all six of our stations, 22 units in all, seven here: data/market/, 2026-11-15 22:40 to 22:58 UTC; the limit here is 1,700 cr) and fits it beside its lasers (cpu 8 of 16, power 17 of 30 on a starter: game/routes/guidebook/mining.md, section 5). The `fit` step of the circuit runner is new: read the first RESULT line. For the command group: four sentinels, so that the miners find harvesters on offer.
